mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts and retail sales both exceed their respective thresholds, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: A supply contraction, indicated by industrial production below 105 (index 2017=100), leads to higher inflation and reduced corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of payroll employment indicates a strong labor market and robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 149000.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth rate (as measured by GDPC1) indicates a healthy economy, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 18600.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market, indicated by high payroll employment (above 149,000 thousand) and low unemployment (below 3.5%), signals potential wage inflation and future monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 149000 and UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A supply expansion, indicated by industrial production above 110 (index 2017=100), reflects robust manufacturing and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 110.
